Equipment:
 SF6 Circuit Breaker 11KV 
 Drawable Version, HA2 & HA3
SACE
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which should be carried out every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the title block 
.

The first draft 
was initiated and tested by eng. Naser El Sayed Abd 
EL-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

The circuit breaker should be switched - off 
 (open)

The circuit breaker be with drawn from its 
 enclosure

The closing and opening springs should be 
 discharged by performig mechanical on - off operations until ensuring that no 
 more operations are available

Caution mark should be placed on the front of 
 circuit breaker enclosure to protect againist the live parts inside the 
 enclosure

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ...etc

The circuit breaker should be switched - off 
 (open)

The circuit breaker be with drawn from its 
 enclosure

The closing and opening springs should be 
 discharged by performig mechanical on - off operations until ensuring that no 
 more operations are available

Caution mark should be placed on the front of 
 circuit breaker enclosure to protect againist the live parts inside the 
 enclosure

correctly

sections.text: Gas Pressure

items:
Check the leakage for 
 all junctions in the gas path

Check the pressure in 
 the normal case (green lamp is on), if not, reset the pressure according to 
 the standared value and ambient temp rature effect
